name: Amplemarket
description: Amplemarket lets agents find and research leads, enrich companies and contacts, review outreach activity, and add leads to lists in the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Amplemarket account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find heads of finance at logistics companies in Germany with 200 to 1,000 employees.
Research this company: tech stack, recent hires, and funding.
What were our past touchpoints with this email address?

apps.name: Amplemarket
apps.description: Lead search, enrichment, and outreach data, over Amplemarket's MCP server with browser sign-in.
